name: I See Alcaz Island In Your Future...
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
As I was saying, champion, in my living years I flirted with becoming a diviner. But, there really wasn't as much profit in it as you might imagine, mostly because it's dangerous and the reagents are rare and expensive. However, I do know enough to be able to pinpoint the final piece of the amulet, and the spirit of my former comrade along with it.

This is where you come in, adventurer. I need you to go to Alcaz Island off the coast of Dustwallow Marsh and collect Bloodkelp from the Strashaz naga that live there.
narrative.objectives: Gather 20 Bloodkelp from the Strashaz naga and then return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
narrative.offerRewardText:
To be honest, adventurer, I'm surprised you made it back in one piece. Then again, I guess Alcaz Island is the least of your worries right now.

Ok, give me a moment here... divination isn't something that you can just snap your fingers and expect accurate answers from.
narrative.requestItemsText: Bloodkelp, adventurer, a big stack of it, that's what I need to power my divinatory spells. You're likely to need to take at least a couple of friends along with you to Alcaz Island to gather it up... those Strashaz are a nasty lot!
